correctness.rationale: Every Fourier eigenvalue is d_k+2g for odd k and d_k for even k. Strict parity-wise monotonicity limits all positive-g collisions to one odd plus one larger even frequency representative, of multiplicity 4 or 3. Vandermonde restrictions prove the exact two-input rank 2n-2C4-C3 and the sharp q=min-driver count for all n>=2,g>0; sine-spacing extremization gives the first resonance and parity loss. A standalone edge-constructed spectral/PBH and direct Kalman verifier passed 24847 checks across 663 graph/rate cases; finite tests supplement the analytic proof.
